# Roy Gardner

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c38 P13](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy Gardner is described as a courtly, adorably handsome young man with glorious, dreamy dark eyes. He is known for his deep, dark, velvety smile.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Roy is romantic, polite, and has an unfailing, deferential courtesy with a pleading, delightful voice. However, he lacks a sense of humor, which can make him seem uninteresting or boring behind his attractive exterior.

_Sources: [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## History

Roy Gardner attended Redmond College until his mother's failing health forced him to temporarily leave his studies and accompany her abroad for two years. Upon returning, he rescued Anne Shirley in a park during a rainstorm by sharing his umbrella. He soon began courting her earnestly, sending her roses, orchids, and poetry. After two years of close companionship and devotion, Roy proposed to Anne in a seaside park pavilion during their graduation season. However, Anne realized she did not truly love him and rejected his proposal, leaving him heartbroken. Roy eventually recovered from the heartache and went on with his life.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P44](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0044), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P1](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0001), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032), [v3 c39 P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004), [v4 c3 P45](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0045)_
